sources.entry: sE2EEnd - End-to-end encrypted file sharing with password protection, download limits, and auto-expiration, integrated with Keycloak for authentication. AGPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: Self-hosted, end-to-end encrypted file and text sharing where encryption happens in the browser and the server only stores ciphertext.
summary.what_it_does: Lets users send files (single or multiple, auto-zipped) and secret notes or text snippets through a web app. Encryption and decryption run in the browser with the Web Crypto API using AES-256-GCM, and the key sits in the URL fragment so it is never sent to the server. Senders can set password protection, per-transfer download limits, and expiration dates, and can revoke transfers from the dashboard. Authentication is handled through Keycloak (OAuth2/OIDC, SSO, LDAP/Active Directory, MFA), and an admin dashboard shows transfers, storage usage, and deletion audit logs. Storage can be the local filesystem or any S3-compatible object store, and the stack is deployed with Docker Compose using images published to GHCR.
use_cases: share confidential files with a team
send a one-time secret or password as a note
temporary file transfer with download limits
self-hosted alternative to hosted file sending services
share files to a phone via QR code
file sharing with SSO and LDAP login
how_to_run: Edit .env to set POSTGRES_PASSWORD, KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD, KEYCLOAK_EXTERNAL_URL and FRONTEND_URL for production
Wait about 30 seconds for Keycloak to import the realm, then open the frontend URL
notable: Zero-knowledge design: the decryption key lives in the URL fragment and never reaches the server
Custom branding (colour, logo, app name) set through environment variables without a rebuild
Multi-language UI with English and French, plus dark mode
Supports S3-compatible storage or local filesystem
Instance policies such as requiring auth for download or enforcing transfer passwords
caveats: Setup depends on several services (Keycloak, PostgreSQL, backend, frontend), and the README says production needs several environment variables set
Keycloak needs about 30 seconds on first boot to import the realm
The README gives no platform limits or maintenance status
